specification.objective: Supersede v4 normal border color and RED oracle: use the standard outline token with accessible contrast against the actual selected and composited adjacent panel.

requirements.statement: Normal selected border uses site outline token and contrasts at least 3:1 against actual selected and composited adjacent surfaces; retain high contrast.
Preserve semantics, keyboard focus and activation, light/dark and compact/desktop behavior; keep text contrast at least 4.5:1.
Supersede v4 oracle with unique assertion failure text and execute both complete test files; archive this lock byte-identically.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Selected border uses outline in normal themes and has at least 3:1 contrast with selected and actual composited adjacent panel in all themes and sizes; semantics and keyboard work.
Full contrast and employee widget test files including global toggle and Enter execute as regression; text contrast thresholds remain unchanged.
Archived v5 contract is byte-identical to external lock.

invariants.statement: High contrast colors, 4.5:1 text contrast, unrelated surfaces and selection interactions remain unchanged.

forbidden_states.statement: Normal selected employee card restores strong yellow background or weakens high contrast.

inputs.statement: Employee list and profile widgets and global theme.

outputs.statement: Normalized scoped surfaces and regression coverage.

failure_semantics.statement: Widget regression fails on insufficient selected border contrast.

baseline_output_contains: Normal selection must use the shared outline token
